university.name: University of Southampton
university.summary: A university whose main teaching campus is Highfield. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate taught degrees across computing, engineering, law, business, finance and health, and publishes automatic fee reductions for postgraduate applicants resident in Pakistan.

courses.title: Data Science
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's on the Highfield campus covering data visualisation, machine learning and the foundations of data science, with optional modules in areas such as natural language processing, and a dissertation project.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:1 degree in computer science or a closely related subject (computer engineering, software engineering, mathematics or statistics, or physics), with a 2:1 in one programming module and a 2:1 in one advanced maths module, ideally statistics and probability.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS overall 6.5 with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. The course page lists IELTS only. A pre-sessional English programme is mentioned as an alternative route.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Southampton Pakistan page says high grades in a 4 or 5 year bachelor's degree from a high-ranking Pakistani institution will be considered for postgraduate entry. It gives no percentage or CGPA threshold.
courses.application_deadline_note: International applicants: Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time. The page advises applying early as applications may close sooner if places fill.
courses.notes: Fee is the 2026 entry figure on the postgraduate fees page and matches the course page; 2027/28 fee not yet published. A GBP 2,000 deposit applies to international full-time students per the course page.

courses.title: Finance
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in finance combining corporate finance, asset pricing and quantitative methods, with optional modules in areas such as behavioural finance and financial technology, and a dissertation.
highlights: Compulsory: Portfolio Theory and Asset Pricing
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 degree in a subject that includes quantitative study, such as finance, sciences, maths, engineering, computer science, economics, or quantitative business or management. The page states that Language Studies and Art, Design and Vocational Studies degrees are not accepted.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS overall 6.5 with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. The course page lists IELTS only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Southampton Pakistan page says high grades in a 4 or 5 year bachelor's degree from a high-ranking Pakistani institution will be considered for postgraduate entry. It gives no percentage or CGPA threshold.
courses.application_deadline_note: International applicants: Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time.
courses.notes: Fee is the 2026 entry figure on the postgraduate fees page and matches the course page; 2027/28 fee not yet published.

courses.title: Management
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's for graduates from non-business backgrounds, covering strategy, people management, operations and financial accounting, with optional modules such as global entrepreneurship, and a dissertation.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 degree. The page states the programme is not recommended for anyone with an existing business or management degree, and that pure vocational subjects such as art and design, film and theatre are not accepted.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS overall 6.5 with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. The course page lists IELTS only and refers to a separate language requirements page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Southampton Pakistan page says high grades in a 4 or 5 year bachelor's degree from a high-ranking Pakistani institution will be considered for postgraduate entry. It gives no percentage or CGPA threshold.
courses.application_deadline_note: International applicants: Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time.
courses.notes: Fee is the 2026 entry figure on the postgraduate fees page and matches the course page; 2027/28 fee not yet published.

courses.title: International Commercial and Corporate Law
courses.overview: A one-year full-time LLM in which students choose from optional modules in commercial, maritime, trade and regulatory law, and complete a dissertation. Applicants may come from law or related non-law disciplines.
highlights: Optional: Law of the World Trade Organization
Optional: Artificial Intelligence Regulation: Theory and Practice
Dissertation (module list shown for 2026 to 2027 entry)
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:1 in a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) or a related non-law discipline. Applicants with significant relevant work experience are considered case by case.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS overall 7.0 with 6.5 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. The course page lists IELTS only.
courses.experience_requirements: Significant relevant work experience is considered on a case-by-case basis.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Southampton Pakistan page says high grades in a 4 or 5 year bachelor's degree from a high-ranking Pakistani institution will be considered for postgraduate entry. It gives no percentage or CGPA threshold.
courses.application_deadline_note: International applicants: Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time.
courses.notes: The fees page lists the fee under the title Law (LLM) at GBP 30,200, which matches this course page; the course page gives no fee year. Module list on the page is labelled for entry in 2026 to 2027, with no separate 2027/28 list seen.

courses.title: Public Health
courses.overview: A one-year full-time Master of Public Health covering epidemiology, statistics and qualitative research, with optional modules such as communicable disease control and global health, and a dissertation or professional project.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 degree. Applicants must show how their degree and interests relate to public health and demonstrate numerical competence.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS overall 6.5 with 6.5 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. The course page lists IELTS only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Southampton Pakistan page says high grades in a 4 or 5 year bachelor's degree from a high-ranking Pakistani institution will be considered for postgraduate entry. It gives no percentage or CGPA threshold.
courses.application_deadline_note: International applicants: Wednesday 18 August 2027, midday UK time.
courses.notes: Fee is the 2026 entry figure on the postgraduate fees page and matches the course page; 2027/28 fee not yet published. The page's compulsory and optional module labels for year 1 are not fully consistent, so highlights are limited to modules the page lists for 2027 to 2028.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: A three-year full-time honours degree on the Highfield campus (UCAS code G400). Year 1 covers programming, algorithmics, mathematics, computer systems, data management and networks and security.
highlights: Compulsory: Programming I and Programming II
Compulsory: Mathematics I and Mathematics II
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAB including mathematics (minimum grade A). With an EPQ: ABB including mathematics at A, plus A in the EPQ. IB Diploma: 34 points overall with 17 at Higher Level including 6 in Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches) or 7 in Mathematics (Applications and Interpretation) at Higher Level. GCSE English and mathematics at grade 4/C.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS overall 6.5 with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. The course page lists IELTS only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Southampton Pakistan page says undergraduate applicants need high grades in UK A levels or 28 to 38 IB points, and that applicants without the standard requirements may qualify through a foundation programme. It gives no Intermediate percentage.
courses.application_deadline_note: The page refers to the UCAS equal consideration deadline without giving a date.
courses.notes: Intake left empty: the course page shows a stale start year and no 2027 start month. The fee of GBP 33,000 is shown without an entry year, and the undergraduate fees page did not show a figure, so the fee year is unverified. Entry requirements are labelled for 2027 to 2028 on the page.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.overview: A three-year full-time engineering degree (UCAS code H300) taught at Highfield and Boldrewood. Year 1 covers engineering design, mechanics and materials, thermofluids, electrical systems and engineering mathematics.
highlights: Compulsory: An Introduction to Engineering Design
courses.academic_requirements: A levels AAA including mathematics and physics, with a pass in the physics practical where separately endorsed. IB Diploma: 36 points overall with 18 at Higher Level, including 6 in Higher Level Physics and 6 in Higher Level Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches) or 7 in Mathematics (Applications and Interpretation). GCSE English and mathematics at grade 4/C.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS overall 6.5 with 6.0 in reading, writing, speaking and listening. The course page lists IELTS only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Southampton Pakistan page says undergraduate applicants need high grades in UK A levels or 28 to 38 IB points, and that applicants without the standard requirements may qualify through a foundation programme. It gives no Intermediate percentage.
courses.application_deadline_note: The page refers to the UCAS equal consideration deadline without giving a date.
courses.notes: Intake left empty: the course page shows a stale start year and no 2027 start month. The fee of GBP 33,500 is shown without an entry year, and the undergraduate fees page did not show a figure, so the fee year is unverified. Entry requirements and year 1 modules are labelled for 2027 to 2028 on the page.

scholarships.name: 75th Anniversary Global Postgraduate Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction awarded automatically to self-funded international students resident in listed countries, including Pakistan, who hold an offer for a full-time, on-campus one-year postgraduate taught course outside Southampton Business School.
scholarships.criteria_text: Permanent resident of a listed country (at least three years before the course starts), self-funded and paying overseas fees, with a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible full-time on-campus one-year taught programme, and deposit paid by the deadline. Southampton Business School programmes are excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: Pay the tuition fee deposit by Saturday 31 July 2027.
scholarships.notes: The page does not state the entry year or whether the reduction applies to the first year only, so value_basis one_off is a best fit. Number of awards not stated. If several Southampton scholarships apply, the highest-value one is given.

scholarships.name: 75th Anniversary Pakistan Postgraduate University of Southampton Business School Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction awarded automatically to new self-funded international students resident in Pakistan who hold an offer for a full-time, on-campus master's programme in Southampton Business School.
scholarships.criteria_text: Permanent resident of Pakistan (at least three years before the course starts), self-funded and paying overseas fees, with a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible full-time on-campus Business School master's programme, and deposit paid by the deadline.
scholarships.deadline_note: Pay the tuition fee deposit by Saturday 31 July 2027.
scholarships.notes: The page does not state the entry year, first-year-only basis or number of awards. Which master's programmes count as Southampton Business School should be confirmed (the page does not list them), e.g. for MSc Finance and MSc Management.

scholarships.name: Dean of Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences Global Talent Award
scholarships.summary: A competitive tuition fee reduction for self-funded international postgraduate taught applicants resident in an eligible country, which includes Pakistan, who hold an offer for a full-time on-campus course in the Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences. Up to 5 awards.
scholarships.criteria_text: Permanent resident of an eligible country, self-funded and paying overseas fees, with a conditional or unconditional offer for an eligible Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences programme, and exceeding course entry requirements. A supporting statement of up to 250 words is required.
scholarships.deadline_note: Applications open in October 2026; deadline 30 April 2027, 5pm UK time. Late applications cannot be accepted.
scholarships.notes: Entry year not stated on the page. Whether each course (for example MSc Data Science) sits in this faculty is not stated, so field_slugs are left empty. The page excludes PGCert, PGDip, Foundation and PGR courses.
